name: webgpt-bridge
description: A private desktop bridge from WebGPT to local MCP agents.
author: WebGPT Bridge

scripts.prepare:agent: npm --prefix agent-runtime ci && npm --prefix agent-runtime run build && npm --prefix agent-runtime run build:native
scripts.pack: npm run build:icon && npm run prepare:tunnel-client:mac && npm run prepare:agent && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:icon && npm run prepare:tunnel-client:mac && npm run prepare:agent && npm run verify:desktop && npm --prefix agent-runtime run acceptance && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:tunnel-client:win && npm run prepare:node-runtime:win && npm run prepare:agent && npm run verify:desktop && npm --prefix agent-runtime run acceptance && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist:mac && npm run dist:win
